messages:
lucas: heads-up: EU DSAR arrived referencing user X and it's correlated with an ongoing vuln triage (incident 2026-4420). legal says we can't permanently delete until forensics confirms scope. can ops do a scoped export with minimal KMS access?
marta: short answer: yes. we should create a short-lived role that only allows Decrypt on specific ciphertext ARNs and s3:PutObject into a quarantined bucket. no changes to key policies.
devon: +1. prefer region-local approach: run a small container in eu-west-1 that assumes the ephemeral role so we avoid cross-region CMK issues.
tara-privacy: legal needs detailed chain-of-custody: who assumed role, start/end times, keys, file names, and approver. if we hold, file a retention-exception with CISO sign-off.
ciso: I will approve up to 48h hold if artifacts are immutable and there is no re-ingest. post policy and the CloudTrail forwarding target for review.
kms-bot: [ALERT] Incident 2026-4420: potential token exposure. Relevant keys: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/rt-9a*, see #incidents.
lucas: draft policy (please sanity-check):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/rt-9a*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::privacy-quarantine/4420/*"}
  ]
}
```

marta: add condition: require aws:RequestTag/erasure-case=4420 and require aws:PrincipalTag/temporary=true. ensure CloudTrail is configured to deliver events to evidence-lockbox and to our SIEM.
devon: ops steps: 1) create role erasure-4420-temp (24h) 2) attach inline policy above 3) run export in eu-west-1 4) upload to s3://privacy-quarantine/4420/ with Object Lock GOVERNANCE for 72h 5) push CloudTrail slice to evidence-lockbox.
tara-privacy: legal will open retention-exception RE-549. need exact timestamps + auditable manifest. who runs the export?
lucas: assigning to devon. please paste the assume/put commands when you run them.
devon: running now: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/erasure-4420-temp --duration-seconds 3600` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/userX-export.tar.gz s3://privacy-quarantine/4420/userX-2026-03-25.tar.gz --tagging "erasure-case=4420"`
kms-bot: [AUDIT] role erasure-4420-temp assumed by devon at 4175001135; actions recorded: kms:Decrypt(4), s3:PutObject(1). Events forwarded to s3://evidence-lockbox/2026/4420/.
tara-privacy: received link, creating RE-549 in legal tracker. tagging @ciso for sign-off. please populate the ticket with exporter, role, key ids, and exact timestamps.
ciso: reviewed evidence in evidence-lockbox. approving RE-549 for 48h hold. Conditions: quarantine objects must not be re-ingested, role revoked at expiry, and final disposition documented.
marta: ops note: beware vector DB backups - embeddings could contain derived PII. we'll schedule a targeted purge + rebuild if deletion is required; that process can take several hours. advise legal of expected delay.
lucas: action items: devon to revoke role at expiration, marta to schedule purge if needed, tara to file RE-549 and attach manifest, ciso to confirm. I'll attach this thread to the incident. :white_check_mark:
